Her own open book stayed low on her supported thighs; one fingertip kept the current page edge while the other hand held the lower cover. She hears the familiar person return and looks up toward their face just LEFT of camera, not directly posing at a lens. Her head turns a little more slowly than the eyes. The brow relaxes and the lips almost make a very small answering smile, as though she has one plain true thought still to share. She need not ask why the person left or claim to have worked all the while. The finger and page remain one natural continuous action; the person may continue this page or simply talk.

CHARACTER AND COMPLETE CHOSEN WARDROBE:
Mutsumi Wakaba/若叶睦, youthful soft face with quiet active judgment, long softly straight PALE MINT-GRAY hair, light fine fringe, TWO slim silver temple clips following the accepted own-left/viewer-right temple relation, clear GOLD-BROWN irises.
